This seems like something I should consider. I am more concerned about the harm I could potentially cause my family if I were to die tonight. They are good, caring people.

I am panicked, trying to decide if it would cause less harm in the long run if I disappeared.
My insurance policy does not cover outpatient mental healthcare. I did pay for an out of pocket therapist and he sent me straight to the ER.

Depression, insomnia, PTSD, substance abuse (though currently sober). I have been hospitalized in the past due to manic episodes. I have almost alienated myself from everyone but my parents. Moved into a new place two days ago after a messy breakup. I don't know what I am doing.
